exposure: Hepatic resection plus intra-operative microwaves ablation
cohort: The study included 20 patients with colorectal cancer liver metastasis undergoing hepatic resection plus intra-operative microwaves and 20 case-matched patients undergoing hepatic resection alone.
finding: Patients with colorectal cancer liver metastasis undergoing surgery plus intra-operative microwaves had similar post-operative results in terms of Relapse-free Survival and post-resection Overall Survival compared with the surgery alone group.
